blocks.text: Every Russian adjective follows one of five patterns, decided by the last letter of the stem and by whether the ending is stressed.

From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53, p. 178. · Every form in the tables on this page is the OpenCorpora dictionary's own, generated by tools/courses/gen_tables.py. OpenCorpora, CC BY-SA 4.0.

exercises.why: The five patterns are set out in the table above: hard (новый), soft (синий), after г к х (русский), after ж ч ш щ (хороший) and with the ending stressed (большой). — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53, p. 178 (Review of Adjectives).
